_README: Batch-path price table (src4_batch only; src4/prices.json is frozen and unchanged). USD per MILLION tokens, LIST (standard, interactive) prices; batch_driver.py multiplies every token class by --price-factor 0.5, the Batch API discount. Keys match like prices.json (exact id or id + -YYYYMMDD). 'periods' are chosen by the end time of the batch that answered a completion (run4 format, UTC); with no time (estimates, worst case) the dearest period is used. batch_published lists Google's own batch prices; tests check 0.5 x list == batch_published for every period.

openrouter:google/gemini-4-argon._note: Confirmed 2026-11-01 against https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (Gemini 4 Argon, paid tier): Standard input $2.00 through November 30, 2026, then $4.00 starting December 1, 2026; output $10.00 then $20.00 ('Output pricing includes thinking tokens'); context caching $0.10 then $0.20 (implicit caching only). Batch: input $1.00 then $2.00, output $5.00 then $10.00, caching $0.05 then $0.10. No prompt-length tiers for this model. The period switch is put at 2026-11-30T00:00Z, a day early, so a batch ending on Nov 30 in any time zone is priced at the higher rate (conservative). cache_write = input: there is no explicit cache write; implicit caching has no write charge. cache_read is never applied: the frozen OpenRouter usage path logs prompt tokens (cached included) as input, so implicitly cached tokens are charged at the full input rate (overestimate; cachedContentTokenCount is kept in batch_state/responses.jsonl and run_info.execution.native_usage).
